## Design

### 2026-10-12 – October 12: #M3RBL RUN!!!

**3.5h**

October 12: #M3RBL RUN!!!

I set myself fresh again from the #5TARBIE project and to be honest, 3D modeling is something I wanted to do, and already knowing the existence of Onshape was even better.

The first thing I did was starting a sketch on the Top plane to establish a clear base. The first problem I ran into is, what's the difference between the center, 2-point, and aligned rectangles? By experimenting on the different types of my sketch plane, I came to the conclusion that the difference is how you draw them:

- Center allows you to drag the shape outwards from the center
- 2-point allows you to start at a corner, and fully draw a shape by pressing the opposite corner
- Align allows you to personally draw the lines of the length and width

Since I wanted my design to be quite big, I created a 120 mm x 120 mm x 4mm base:

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 143533](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/0cf2c6d3e5339d3b7a8c6f87b61b6230350f70a7f234ba65b312ea52bbfa389f.png)

I wanted to make a custom version that isn't exactly like the guide, so I created another sketch, as circle this time and elevated to support part of the course outward, or just to make the design more creative. While in the process, I also customized the colors:

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 154001](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/e2bfc450013d6f69db1b1d16f369162132ed44f1408a47e207c781a9a5b35d23.png)

During the base process, I wondered about many things:

- How can you move the object (tried "Transform" but didn't work out. Instead, make a new sketch)
- How can you create the elevated circular platform in the first place? (elevate the "Extrude")
- How can you change the color of your design? "Select the "parts" option below the features and click on "edit appearance" to choose your desired color)

Moving on to the tracks, I had no issues with the line from prior knowledge, but I didn't know why I had to add another plane when there's already 3 planes set. I also learned that this plane, "Plane 1" needed the sketch 3's (the line) line segment and one of its end points:

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 161525](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/d29414b0bc785855fd67e5469428ce51c1d21b59d4faf45a938d082f5b056ff3.png)

After setting up the line, I read the instructions and after establishing the tube of my basic track, adding lines, I trimmed off the lines and parts within them to create the ramp of my marble course, and using Sweep to create a 3D version of my basic track!:

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 164405](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/86440d4eadbf52e4ac36c060339992b604269200f11695a892b6b34a6fea8fe3.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 164655](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/f3e059462d4968149117c53ad79cb8b4c638bf0838b77f9d84615789481979a8.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 165416](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/042560c52e35cb949e84ce480d3349c5eca478412fffd231a6db8d1202001231.png)

### 2026-10-15 – October 14: #M3RBL RUN!!!

**3.5h**

October 14: #M3RBL RUN!!!

Before continouing my tracks, I realized I had missed one step into the process, the spline. Making the spline was easy to do now that I knew how to sketch a rectangle, and I made it into the shape of a golf course:

![Screenshot 2026-10-14 203052](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/e291f86d0c5e909b35a2067558f71288b7dff113af92173a117526c1fc2b1693.png)

During the process, I could seperate the shapes so that they don't overlap so that appearance doesn't get messy. For this reason besides the golf course base, I also elevated my circular platform in case when I build this project I wouldn't be able to overlap it.

The only question I have for later is: How will I connect my M3RBL RUN pieces when I'm building it???

...........

Seriously, I have to delete my basic track!?
...........................................

After spending some time making Plane 2, I ran into a dead end, what entity do I sketch if the part is deleted, then I realized it was a sketch line, not the entire figure. A sketch like this only requires the line, no additional vertex to create a slanted plane:

![Screenshot 2026-10-14 210717](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/01a81b56707ca7595ba2338f38f95d95958ff6a5232e9aed645e60019413564e.png)

The advanced track has the line+fillet method, and using the fillet method, I had a hard time finding how to change the radius, so I used the fillet tool and repeating it multiple times, until when I gave up and moved back into the sketch, the radius 12 mm will pop up instantly???:

![Screenshot 2026-10-14 212805](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/7ba34c6fe1ce6f405ea61ea86eaaa49f8954e19b7246d50c47ec5dbfb6ab4f85.png)

Anyway, I noticed the fillet radius has to be more than 12 mm, but how? how can I make the circle fit into the angle?

I tried longer lengths, and it worked! The circle could fit into the elongated lines, and I made a circle-like side just like the guide! (Though the horizontal line is originally 20, I had to make it 45 mm):

![Screenshot 2026-10-14 213708](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/4263b779b31cde39a4665de7db73ae5aa1573a4f9b284381c0792491b6406f75.png)

### 2026-10-17 – October 17: #M3RBL RUN!!!

**5h**

October 17: #M3RBL RUN!!!

Going back into it, I wanted to see what my line + fillet tactic looks like with sweep, and it turned out horribly! The track went upside down, and it'll make the marble fall. I changed the reference view for Plane 2 with the reference with just the edge sketch, and surprisingly it worked!:

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 144252](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/785dfb09c1ca177c00ef08b6248b6251f061f9796b829699e53ad2270d713170.png)

Using the Line +

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 151102](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/fe177db2b275296e5d2040f4142fb1ef17896d5b831935e79caba263ddc9391b.png)

Circle method was difficult because I didn't know if there was needing any fillet, and I had errors on my angles:

I realized i had to delete the - sign to make it work again, and also instead of using 120 degree angles, I used 90 degree angles to create half circle turns. I used a lot of tangents to connect the lines, and here's my final result!:

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 154834](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/f2052814200bc514beff44c9715e9a65373bdfa82281d3dd8cb22f98395530b9.png)

After making critical decisions, I redesigned the entire thing (don't ask me why) to a more flashy approach, such as making a hexagonal-covered  base and different planes for different advanced track techinques :

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/e6528a3663e47634c2498066860da8a0fd29b88026467b5013dc82f966b46ae0.png)

When making the base, I had to be careful not to cause any errors so that everything is ruined, so I checked on one hexagon each time, making sure each side was 20 mm long and the angle measurements were 120 degrees.

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 184923](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/b9408d41eb145c36a63ba9b4744a586c5d92c3acc655647773888ed58d2f3373.png)
